scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.dev:main: npm run build:main && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-uv.mjs darwin-arm64 && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-uv.mjs win32-x64 && electron-builder --win
scripts.pack: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-uv.mjs && electron-builder --dir
